_comment: Placeholder, non-secret values only. Real ConnectionStrings/Redis values belong in `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or environment variables / Key Vault (prod) — never in this file. See .claude/rules/backend.md and CLAUDE.md rule 9.

Observability._comment: P0-13 OTLP export (trace/metric/log). Empty OtlpEndpoint = export disabled (dev/CI default) — logs still go to console JSON. On the VPS set the collector's base URL, e.g. https://otlp.siristudiophoto.com (HttpProtobuf) or http://collector:4317 (Grpc); no /v1/... path, both exporters append it themselves. Not a secret — OtlpApiKey (set via env, not here) is. ServiceName is the bare '<project>-<component>' part; Program.cs appends '-<env>' itself.

DataProtection._comment: EncryptionKeyBase64 below is a randomly-generated dev-only placeholder (not derived from any real secret) — same 'obviously fake, lets dev/CI boot' convention as Identity:Jwt:SigningKey above. Protects InstructorPayoutAccounts' bank account numbers/tax ids at rest. The real production key belongs in `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or env/Key Vault (prod) per security.md; generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` — never commit a real one here.

Email._comment: Provider is deliberately EMPTY: no mail is silently dropped. Set Email:Provider=Smtp (+ Email:Smtp:*) to deliver mail — Production refuses to start otherwise. 'Log' is an explicit opt-in that delivers nothing (tests only). While empty, every send fails with email.provider_not_configured and the outbox retries it.

Seo._comment: Placeholder — no real production domain decided yet (docs/DECISIONS.md's Q3 follow-up notes the same gap for CORS). Must become the real production origin before launch.

Meilisearch._comment: Course + instructor-name search engine. Url and ApiKey are deliberately EMPTY here: set them per environment as Meilisearch__Url / Meilisearch__ApiKey (and Meilisearch__DocumentsIndexUid if it differs) via env or `dotnet user-secrets` for BOTH Siri.Api and Siri.Workers - the ApiKey is a SECRET, never commit it. While Url is empty or ApiKey is empty/CHANGE_ME the feature is simply OFF and the search runs on PostgreSQL (pg_trgm), exactly as before. Enabled=false forces that fallback. The key needs search, documents.add/get/delete, indexes.create/get, settings.update, tasks.get (a master key works).

Live._comment: P11-03 live classes. Provider: GoogleMeet (default - create Google Meet rooms for instructors who connected Google, otherwise they paste a link) | ManualOnly (never call Google) | Logging (DEVELOPMENT ONLY - fake Google/Meet; Production refuses to boot with it). PublicBaseUrl (frontend origin) defaults to Seo:PublicBaseUrl; AllowedMeetingHosts defaults to meet.google.com, zoom.us, teams.microsoft.com, teams.live.com (sub-domains included); OrganizerEmail defaults to no-reply@<host of PublicBaseUrl>. No secrets in this section.

Google._comment: Google OAuth web client used to create Calendar events with Meet rooms on an instructor's OWN calendar (no platform-wide credential). ClientId empty = the connect-Google feature is OFF and instructors paste meeting links instead; the rest of the system works unchanged. ClientSecret is a SECRET: set it with `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or env Integrations__Google__ClientSecret (prod) for BOTH Siri.Api and Siri.Workers - never here. RedirectUri must match Google Cloud exactly: <API origin>/api/live/instructor/google/callback. Scopes default to openid, email and calendar.events.owned.

Catalog._comment: P4-03 attachment upload and validation configuration.

VirusScan._comment: No virus-scanning engine is integrated yet. Required (default) = attachment uploads are refused with 503 attachment.virus_scanner_not_configured rather than ever reporting an unscanned file as clean. Disabled = explicit, logged opt-in to unscanned uploads (Development only; Production refuses to boot with it).

Seller._comment: The legal entity printed as SELLER on receipts / tax invoices. Deliberately EMPTY (no invented company): any of CompanyName, TaxId (13 digits) and Address left unset falls back to the same company's Payout:PayerCompanyName / PayerTaxId / PayerAddress. Until real values exist for all three — via `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or env Commerce__Seller__* / Payout__Payer* (prod) — the receipt endpoints answer 503 receipt.seller_not_configured, and Production refuses to boot. BranchLabel, ContactEmail and Website are optional (left off the document when blank).

Contact._comment: SupportEmail is the real inbox the team is emailed at when the contact form is submitted. Deliberately EMPTY (no invented address): while blank, messages are still saved (visible in the admin contact list) but no email is queued.

EmailConfirmation._comment: Placeholder — the frontend has no /confirm-email route yet (P0-15 is backend-only). Must become the real production frontend origin before launch.

PasswordReset._comment: Placeholder — the frontend has no /reset-password route yet (P0-21 is backend-only). Must become the real production frontend origin before launch.

Security._comment: SE-03 (docs/SECURITY.md §2). Not a secret — safe to commit. Per-account overrides live on Users.MaxConcurrentSessionsOverride, not here.

Jwt._comment: SigningKey below is an obviously-fake, randomly-generated placeholder (CHANGE_ME_DEV_ONLY_ prefix, same convention as ConnectionStrings' CHANGE_ME) — never the real production key. The real key belongs in `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or env/Key Vault (prod), per security.md; never commit a real one here.

Google._comment: Sign in with Google (Google Identity Services ID-token flow). ClientId is the PUBLIC OAuth web client id from Google Cloud Console (not a secret; the web app embeds the same value). Leave empty to switch Google sign-in off. The site's origins (e.g. https://siriupskill.siristudiophoto.com, http://localhost:4202) must be listed under 'Authorized JavaScript origins' on that client. DiscoveryUrl only changes to a local fake provider in dev/tests.

Seed._comment: P0-37 dev/test bootstrap accounts (`dotnet run --project backend/src/Siri.Api -- --seed`). AdminEmail is a non-secret placeholder, safe to commit. AdminPassword/TestUserPassword are the literal string CHANGE_ME on purpose — IdentitySeeder refuses to run while either still has that value. Set real ones via `dotnet user-secrets set "Identity:Seed:AdminPassword" "..."` / `...:TestUserPassword` (run from backend/src/Siri.Api) before seeding for real. See CLAUDE.md's seed/bootstrap section.

Payout._comment: P6-04 payout batch & 50 ทวิ tax certificate configuration. PayerCompanyName/PayerTaxId/PayerAddress must be set with real corporate entity info before generating official tax certificates in production. EstimatedPaymentFeePercent configures estimated payment fee deduction (e.g. 3.30).

Payment._comment: Values are deliberately EMPTY (no fake keys): without real keys the app still boots but payment endpoints answer 503 payment.provider_not_configured. Real Stripe test/live keys belong in `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or env/Key Vault (prod) per security.md — never commit real keys here. Production refuses to start without live keys.

VideoProvider._comment: Values are deliberately EMPTY (no fake ids/keys): without real Bunny Stream settings the app still boots but upload/status/playback answer 503 video.provider_not_configured. Real values belong in `dotnet user-secrets` (dev) or env/Key Vault (prod) per security.md — never commit real values here. Production refuses to start unless all are set. ReadOnlyApiKey is also the Bunny webhook HMAC secret.
